# OFFICE-X

> OFFICE-X is an OQVIAN desktop office for local AI agents, extended with an optional Shared Office for real teammates and their agents. The OFFICE-X app mark and OQVIAN company identity are distinct.

## Product

- A local multi-agent office with the inherited floor, terminals, coordination, and agent controls.
- Shared Office presence between fingerprint-pinned teammate devices.
- Three owner-controlled inbound access levels: task requests requiring approval, delegated agent prompts, and full terminal control.
- Terminal output is off until explicitly enabled for a teammate and local agent.
- Connections can use direct peer-to-peer, a configured OQVIAN Circuit Relay v2 host, or a self-hosted Circuit Relay v2 host.

## Current deployment status

This source tree does not include a live OQVIAN managed relay endpoint or public download repository. Managed relay availability requires deployment configuration. Direct peer-to-peer needs a reachable public TCP route. A self-hostable relay implementation and its deployment guide are included in the repository.
